contexts.statement: Assess all 34 historical artifacts in PRIOR_DRAFTS.json under OBJECTIVE.md; review old Argus arguments without auditing the original manuscripts or inheriting historical acceptance.

definitions.unit: one mathematical argument, with versions and duplicates merged but distinguished
definitions.support: an Engineer recommendation, not native independent acceptance
definitions.arithmetic_applicability: realization of the stated cochains, integral maps and uniform arithmetic hypotheses, not a polynomial identity

claims.natural_statement: For every commutative ring the displayed cyclic and Frobenius identities hold under their displayed hypotheses; the integer Fox and half-factor factorizations hold universally. These identities alone do not identify arithmetic local cochains.

For every homomorphism r:A->B of abelian groups and positive integer h killing ker(r) and coker(r), there is a canonical natural additive D_h with r(D_h(b))=h^2*b. For h>=2 every factor q natural on all such diagrams must be divisible by h^2.

The old ring-class descent application is conditional on uniform scalar torsion control, the stated Heegner trace/reduction relations, connected unramified descent and the actual compatible target diagrams; the inventoried algebra does not establish all these inputs.

The finite-precision Fox coefficient calculation supports a split paired local model only with the stated action, cochain comparison and cup-product data. Retained H0 and omitted H2 are essential; an arithmetic local quasi-isomorphism is not proved by the polynomial factorizations alone.

The retained boundary formula follows from its specified contraction witness and commuting square. Integral Shapiro and Selmer duality apply with their actual cochain maps, perfectness, orthogonal complements and compatibility homotopies, not from rational cohomology agreement alone.

For compatible exact perfect integral DVR strict/finite/singular/relaxed diagrams with the old generic rank-one and concentration hypotheses, nonzero switched localizations v and Jv and the actual dual class functionals give equal determinant valuations, without primitivity; finitely many admissible switches introduce only units.

The displayed matrix diamond is an algebraic construction over every DVR and every nonzero p: it retains strict torsion (O/p)^2, integral relative homotopies and perfect derived plane pairings, and has determinant coordinates -p^-2 and p^-2. It is not an elliptic-curve realization.

The historical package supports abstract algebra and conditional determinant comparison, not unconditional arithmetic applicability, a hypothesis-complete source counterexample, the pointwise converse or rational H10. Downstream manuscript claims remain reference dependencies, not new audit targets.
Every listed historical artifact and substantive embedded claim has a nonduplicative disposition and a substantive unit assessment, ready for the native independent Reviewer.
Rational cohomology groups and generic dimension data alone determine the integral determinant tensors and compatible duality maps needed for the switch.
